column1: # AMD RX 7900 XT, system Mesa 26.0.8, PyTorch 2.13.0+rocm7.2, October 31 2026.
# Branch p3hpc-talk-op-bench c5486382 shapes, precision, inputs and native timings.
# AMD PYTORCH TIMING ADAPTATION: HIP event interval around a graph of 30 serial ops / 30; median of 30 replays; profiler OFF.
# Native GPU: original branch summed per-pass Vulkan timestamps; 30 samples, 1s warmup, strict f32, cooperative matrices disabled.
# These are different device timing boundaries: the HIP graph interval includes device dispatch gaps; native sums omit between-pass gaps.
# Native wall includes profiling; Torch wall uses ordinary unprofiled host calls. Do not compare wall columns directly.
# Prior NVIDIA/Intel rows were collected with profilers; rerun with a common timing method for publication-level cross-vendor claims.
# Each engine uses its branch input initialization; inputs differ between engines. Winograd TFLOP/s uses effective direct-convolution FLOPs.
